text:
Tessa Miller: Lumen Telemetry reached out asking to onboard a compact summarizer+extractor for device telemetry support chats. Requirements: PHI-safe redaction, fast embeddings for similarity search, and a 2-step summarization (short+long). POC requested in 3 weeks, production in 7. Renewal touchpoint in 2 months — flagged medium risk if POC slip.
Omar Rizvi: Can we get their QPS/latency targets? Also confirm whether they require Private deployment / HSM in prod.
Tessa Miller: From intake: steady ~12 QPS, spikes to 40, 95p latency target 180ms for short summaries. Production must be Private with HSM. POC OK hosted with synthetic PHI only. They want perf/cost for 6B-quant vs 11B-fp16.
Jin Park: Suggested POC plan: hosted sanitized dataset -> dedicated private tenant for integration -> on-prem if legal requires. For latency: 6B int8 + kv-cache might meet 95p ~150ms on a mid-range GPU. 11B likely needs larger nodes.
Omar Rizvi: ops-bot, can you schedule a microbench for both configs and post node/RAM estimates?
ops-bot: Microbench job queued: lumen-telemetry-341222-2026-06-10T01:00Z. Results will be posted in #eng-runtime.
Jin Park: Security asks: deterministic redaction + tokenization audit, audit logs for inputs/outputs, and HSM-backed key wraps. We'll require a 5% manual review on flagged outputs during POC. Retention for flagged artifacts: 90 days.
Tessa Miller: Action items: (1) Jin to draft eval harness spec + sample adversarial list by Tue; (2) Omar to draft POC deployment notes + cost comps by Wed; (3) Tessa to coordinate legal addendum and secure upload method (SFTP vs presigned) by EOD Mon.
Omar Rizvi: Draft POC config to propose:
```json
{"model":"redwood-6b-int8","batching":{"max_tokens":200,"max_batch_size":8},"latency_target_ms":160}
```
Tessa Miller: Please loop in DevEx/docs for the POC kickoff so integration docs get validated early. I'll flag the account for weekly check-ins until POC completes.
Jin Park: For eval harness: sample 200 transcripts, 40 adversarial prompts (PII injection, context shuffling), metrics: PHI-leakage-rate, rouge, retrieval-MRR for embeddings. Output JSONL with fields transcript_id, prompt, output, leakage_flag, mrr_score.
Tessa Miller: Thanks — keeping this thread as the single source of truth. I'll add the intake doc and legal note when confirmed. :white_check_mark:
